card.name: The warning to keep out of children's reach
card.fires_on: The linking word (of, fuera, from) right after 'keep out', 'mantengase', or 'away' in storage warnings about keeping a product away from children, pets or eyes.

modes.label: The English keep-out phrase
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'from' after 'keep out' or 'away' in child-safety storage statements.
modes.example: Keep out<< of>> reach of children.

modes.label: The Spanish keep-out phrase
modes.description: The word 'fuera' after 'mantengase' in Spanish warnings before 'del alcance de los niños'.
modes.example: Advertencias: Venta bajo prescripción médica, mantengase<< fuera>> del alcance de los niños.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the next words 'reach of children' or 'the eyes', pushing toward prevention and avoidance wording.
card.plain: It responds to the small linking word in storage warnings such as 'keep out of reach of children', just before the phrase finishes.
